attributes.residual: real 18, and the mechanism is now NAMED to one register. TARGET, at +0x134..+0x15c: `fdivs f0,f0,f1` (the divide, an unnamed compiler temp in f0) / `fcmpo cr0,f0,f31` / `bge ->148` / `fmr f1,f31` (carrier := pt01) / `b ->15c` / `lfs f1,@lbl_80343BEC` (carrier := the constant, and the same load feeds the compare) / `fcmpo cr0,f0,f1` / `ble ->158` / `b ->15c` / `fmr f1,f0` (carrier := the divide) / `frsp f0,f1`. OURS: the carrier and the divide temp COALESCE into f0, so the else arm's assignment is a no-op, the `b ->15c` at +0x154 is not needed and is absent, and a compensating `fmr` appears. The whole residual is that one coalescing decision: the target keeps two live f64 webs (temp f0, carrier f1) where MWCC gives us one. Probe (2) DID create two webs -- it produced the target's exact branch skeleton including the `b` -- but paid for it with a dead `fmr f1,f0` at +0x13c because `ratio` remained a named local as well, i.e. THREE webs. DO NOT RETRY the four shapes above; the untried direction is a form in which the divide is a compiler temp AND the carrier is a source local AND no third named local exists, which none of the four achieved because MWCC coalesces whichever single source local is assigned the divide value.
